Night is falling, and the night of this land is not like the day.

At dusk tonight's Omen is told: it changes the whole open world until dawn. Soon after nightfall Nightlords rise in the wild, and warbands of Shadow Raiders may come for the hunters. In the last hour, the Witching Hour, the dead rise again.

Hunting at night earns Night Watch points; the best hunters are rewarded at dawn. In Giran the Night Market opens its stalls until morning.

Type .night or open Night on the Community Board (Alt+B) to see what tonight holds.
